title: Nacli 101/182 Reverse Holo Common - Paradox Rift Pokemon Pack Fresh Near Mint NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Nacli 101/182 Reverse Holo Common card from the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set is a must-have for any Pokemon TCG collector. Featuring the Fighting type and a Beast creature/monster, this card is sure to add some diversity to your collection. The card is made from high-quality card stock material and has a foil finish, making it a durable and unique addition to your collection.

This card is perfect for players and collectors alike, with its standard size and English language. It features Chase features and is manufactured by Pokemon, one of the most trusted names in the industry. Add this card to your collection today and take your Pokemon TCG game to the next level!
